- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.

TASK T46 · W3 · Replay turn cap scales with the original session
GOAL: A DeepSeek replay of task T12 stopped at the 40-turn cap (error max_turns, F5) although the original session took 59 turns.
A fixed cap misjudges big tasks. The cap should come from the task itself.
READ: src/replay/run.ts (DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS, maxTurns option), src/replay/tasks.ts (ReplayTask), src/types.ts (Session).
OWNS: src/replay/run.ts, src/replay/tasks.ts, tests/replay-turns.test.ts, and any assertion in tests/replay-run*.test.ts that encodes
the fixed default (you may modify those; say which)
BUILD: ReplayTask gains originalTurns (from the session transcript's assistant turns when known, else null). The per-run turn cap is
max(60, ceil(2 × originalTurns)) when known, else 80; an explicit opts.maxTurns still wins. The cap used is recorded on the Replay
(field turn_cap).
ACCEPTANCE: tests: a task with originalTurns 59 gets cap 118; unknown → 80; explicit maxTurns overrides; existing tests pass.
TEST: bun test tests/replay-turns.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.
